'''Aerowynn''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Drall/Legends|Drall]] who lived during the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|resurgent Sith Empire]]. During the Empire's [[Battle of Corellia|invasion]] on [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]], Aerowynn and many of the Drall aided the [[Corellian/Legends|Corellians]] to liberate Corellia. When he encountered [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Veet]] and his squad, he resisted initial attempts to allow them by taking his weapons factory until he was executed.
